CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.revene_externals
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(50),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(50),
    Revenue VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'revenue/',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = raw_csv_format
);


SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.revene_externals;


SELECT *
FROM sys.external_file_formats;
